decisions.briefing: NASDAQ +1.1% and S&P 500 +0.7% confirm a risk-on day, so with 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold we deployed into our three highest-scoring, non-overbought momentum candidates (PPC, KRMN, JBS) rather than sitting on idle cash. Existing positions are held unchanged since nothing here warrants an exit on a constructive market day.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market gains today, with the NASDAQ up 1.1% and the S&P 500 up 0.7%, reflect a general risk-on tone among investors rather than any single catalyst noted in available data. Momentum names with strong technical setups (RSI in bullish range, MACD crossovers, price above moving averages) tend to outperform on days like this as capital flows into names already showing institutional buying interest. No specific news headlines were available to cite for today's move.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍上漲，納斯達克指數上升1.1%，標普500指數上升0.7%，反映市場整體偏向風險偏好（risk-on）氛圍，而非單一特定消息面因素。在這類日子，技術面強勁的動能股（RSI處於多頭區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於移動均線）往往表現較佳，因資金傾向流入已顯示機構買盤興趣的個股。今日暫無可引用的具體新聞標題。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, based on the idea that strong recent performance tends to continue in the near term. Today's buys were chosen because they showed multiple confirming technical signals together — bullish RSI, a MACD crossover, and price above the 20-day moving average — rather than relying on just one indicator.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資（Momentum Investing）是指買入已經處於上升趨勢的股票，其理念是近期表現強勁的股票在短期內往往會延續走勢。今日選股是因為同時出現多個技術指標確認訊號——RSI處於多頭區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於20日均線——而非僅依賴單一指標做判斷。
